## MATRIX Qwen Image 2.1 Dataset Workflow - Normal

Builds a 32-image LoRA training dataset of one character with Qwen Image 2.1: HEAD (8 expressions and angles), HEAD 360, UPPER BODY 360 and FULL BODY 360 (each 8 turns from front to back). Every card is its own group with its own prompt; each body area has its own reference panel. All 32 cards are on by default. Download what you miss and put it in the folders shown in the tree.

### custom nodes
- [MATRIX-LAB-Nodes](https://github.com/JsonMatrixLab/MATRIX-LAB-Nodes/tree/f71fb38dea39f6052ff4e883c18fecc7ec07d199): MATRIX QWEN IMAGE 2.1 RESOLUTION
- [ComfyUI-Fantastic-MiniMaxH3-PromptBuilder](https://github.com/Adudeguyman/ComfyUI-Fantastic-MiniMaxH3-PromptBuilder/tree/23038f5050acdcbb8e938bfd7c87a18d2cc84aab): Fantastic H3 Media Loader, Fantastic H3 Reference Splitter
- [rgthree-comfy](https://github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy/tree/449c58fcdd612f7733e54c51f6758ead63fa180b): Power Lora Loader, Fast Groups Bypasser, Fast Actions Button

### diffusion_models
- [qwen_image_2.1_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1/resolve/9a44dbdb47cefd046be9c0a13476192f34c8db8e/diffusion_models/qwen_image_2.1_int8_convrot.safetensors) (7.26 GB)

### text_encoders
- [qwen3vl_8b_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1/resolve/9a44dbdb47cefd046be9c0a13476192f34c8db8e/text_encoders/qwen3vl_8b_int8_convrot.safetensors) (9.35 GB)

### vae
- [qwen_image_2.1_vae_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1/resolve/9a44dbdb47cefd046be9c0a13476192f34c8db8e/vae/qwen_image_2.1_vae_bf16.safetensors) (676 MB)

### loras
- [bfs_head_v1.1_qwen_2.1.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Alissonerdx/BFS-Best-Face-Swap/resolve/0ca3913ade4b4ada458d60c232354e8586c4c181/bfs_head_v1.1_qwen_2.1.safetensors) (260 MB): head LoRA, strength 0.9, off by default
- [p_qwen_image_2.1_8step_v0.1.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/PrunaAI/Pruna-Qwen-Image-2.1/resolve/113e63bb993001b3411eb3470b84fc444040cd7e/p_qwen_image_2.1_8step_v0.1.safetensors) (336 MB): 8-step speed LoRA, off by default

```text
ComfyUI/
├── custom_nodes/
│   ├── MATRIX-LAB-Nodes/
│   ├── ComfyUI-Fantastic-MiniMaxH3-PromptBuilder/
│   └── rgthree-comfy/
└── models/
    ├── diffusion_models/
    │   └── qwen_image_2.1_int8_convrot.safetensors
    ├── text_encoders/
    │   └── qwen3vl_8b_int8_convrot.safetensors
    ├── vae/
    │   └── qwen_image_2.1_vae_bf16.safetensors
    └── loras/
        ├── bfs_head_v1.1_qwen_2.1.safetensors
        └── p_qwen_image_2.1_8step_v0.1.safetensors
```

### anchor panels

Load pictures in order in ANCHORS HEAD, ANCHORS HEAD 360, ANCHORS UPPER BODY and ANCHORS FULL BODY. The prompting note gives the required image ladder and tag rules. All pictures must show the same person in the same simple outfit, and their aspect ratio must match that section's MATRIX QWEN IMAGE 2.1 RESOLUTION choice.

### quality and fast setup

Quality (default): 25 steps, BFS head LoRA OFF, Pruna 8-step LoRA OFF. Fast: switch the Pruna row ON in the Power Lora Loader and set the four STEPS fields to 8. BFS expects picture 1 to be a body reference, while this workflow puts the face first; turn its row on only to compare.

### size

Each section has its own MATRIX QWEN IMAGE 2.1 RESOLUTION node: HEAD, HEAD 360 and UPPER BODY 360 use 3:4 (1792x2400), FULL BODY 360 uses 2:3 (1696x2528).

### re-roll and switches

Read every section left to right: ANCHORS, SIZE / STEPS / RE-ROLL and its bypass controls, then cards 1 through 8. Each section has STEPS 25 and a RE-ROLL number (HEAD 1000, HEAD 360 2000, UPPER BODY 3000, FULL BODY 4000); every card seed is that number plus the card number. Change RE-ROLL for a new section set. The `<SECTION> ON` and `<SECTION> OFF` buttons in front of each section enable or bypass all eight card groups at once; OFF means that section renders nothing. Single cards still switch in 04/06/08/10. Each card saves one PNG with Save Image into dataset/head, dataset/head360, dataset/upper360 or dataset/full360.

### prompting

Read the prompting note beside this note before loading references. Directions use the image edges: LEFT or RIGHT edge of the image, 180 = seen from directly behind. Describe framing, camera, pose, expression and light; do not describe hair, eyes, skin or age, and use no names. Use only with AI-generated characters or images you have the rights and consent for.

License: Qwen Research License, non-commercial; BFS MIT.

## Prompting with Qwen Image 2.1 tags

Every active picture becomes a reference in input order. Fill required slots first, never leave a gap, and put optional views after them.

### image ladder

| Section | Required pictures | Optional pictures |
|---|---|---|
| 03 HEAD | picture 1: face | up to 2 extra face views |
| 05 HEAD 360 | picture 1: face | up to 2 extra face views |
| 07 UPPER BODY 360 | picture 1: face; picture 2: upper body with outfit | up to 2 extra views |
| 09 FULL BODY 360 | picture 1: face; picture 2: upper body; picture 3: full body with outfit and shoes | up to 2 extra views |

### how the numbers count

- `<imageN>` counts only active pictures, in input order.
- Never leave a gap. An empty picture 2 turns picture 3 into `<image2>`, so every later prompt points at the wrong picture.
- Prompts name only the required tags. Any further reference pictures are additional views of the same person.
- All pictures must show the same person in the same outfit. Clothing in HEAD comes from picture 1, in UPPER from picture 2, and in FULL from picture 3. Use simple clothing you want in every image.

### size

IMPORTANT: input-picture aspect ratio must match the aspect selected in that section's MATRIX QWEN IMAGE 2.1 RESOLUTION node. For example, use 3:4 pictures when 3:4 is selected. The encoder latent follows the first reference size, so a different size shifts the edit.

### switches

`<SECTION> ON` and `<SECTION> OFF` in front of each section switch all eight cards on or off at once. OFF bypasses all eight card groups, so that section renders nothing. Single cards still switch in 04/06/08/10.

### LoRA

BFS head LoRA is off by default because it expects picture 1 to be a body reference, while this workflow puts the face first. Turn its row on only to compare. Pruna is also off by default.

Use only with AI-generated characters or images you have the rights and consent for.
